ha_claude_code:
claude mcp add --transport http xomtra http://homeassistant.local:8000/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer xmt_..."
dk_tools:
# Debian, Ubuntu
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git curl
# Fedora, RHEL
sudo dnf install -y git curl
dk_clone:
git clone --branch "v$VERSION" --depth 1 https://github.com/xomtra/xomtra.git
cd xomtra/deploy/compose
for f in SHA256SUMS "xomtra-$VERSION-images.env"; do
  curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/xomtra/xomtra/releases/download/v$VERSION/$f"
done
dk_up:
docker compose up -d
docker compose ps
dk_setup: docker compose exec admin xomtra-admin setup-link
dk_ca:
docker compose exec caddy cat /data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt \
  | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256
dk_claude_code:
claude mcp add --transport http xomtra https://<server>/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer xmt_..."
dk_upgrade:
cp -p .env ".env.bak-$(date +%F)"
git fetch --depth 1 origin tag "v$VERSION"
git checkout -q "v$VERSION"
for f in SHA256SUMS "xomtra-$VERSION-images.env"; do
  curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/xomtra/xomtra/releases/download/v$VERSION/$f"
done
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
dk_pull:
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d
dk_ca_local:
openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in ~/Downloads/xomtra-ca.crt
# Windows: certutil -dump %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\xomtra-ca.crt | findstr /i sha256
dk_trust:
# macOS
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot \
  -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain ~/Downloads/xomtra-ca.crt
# Windows (as administrator)
certutil -addstore -f Root %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\xomtra-ca.crt
dk_backup:
docker compose stop
mkdir -p ~/xomtra-backup
for v in $(docker volume ls -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=xomtra); do
  docker run --rm -v "$v":/v:ro -v ~/xomtra-backup:/b alpine tar czf "/b/$v.tgz" -C /v .
done
cp .env ~/xomtra-backup/
dk_down:
docker compose down -v --rmi all --remove-orphans
docker volume ls --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=xomtra   # empty
cd ../../.. && rm -rf xomtra
docker image prune -f
dk_mcp_remove:
claude mcp list                  # find the server with https://<server>/mcp
claude mcp remove <name>         # add -s user or -s project if you added it with that scope
dk_untrust:
# macOS: show the SHA-1 hash, then delete the certificate by it
security find-certificate -a -c "xomtra local CA" -Z /Library/Keychains/System.keychain | grep SHA-1
sudo security delete-certificate -Z <sha1-hash> /Library/Keychains/System.keychain
# Windows (as administrator)
certutil -store Root "xomtra local CA"
certutil -delstore Root <cert-hash>
